title: DOE SRT and NNSA Office of Secure Transportation move recovered UFO material between labs

tellings.quote: operations. The DOE and/NSA employ two other agencies I think are highly likely involved in UFO retrieval operations or passing recovered UFO materials between US national labs here in the continental United States.

plain: Two security units inside the US Department of Energy, the government department that runs the country's national laboratories and nuclear weapons work, may be the ones that pick up crashed UFOs and carry recovered material between those labs. That is the view of a researcher who goes by UAPGerb, who names an armed guard force known as the Special Response Team and the Office of Secure Transportation, the unit that moves nuclear material for the department's nuclear weapons agency. He offers it as his own guess, "highly likely involved" in his words, without naming a source, and if he is right it would mean the hidden handling of such material runs through ordinary federal security channels.
